Then clamp only if still out of bounds.","expected_effect":"Repaired trials retain a positive cosine with the search direction, raising repaired-trial success rate toward the non-repaired baseline and reducing the F1/F7/F10 gap.","failure_prediction":"On highly multimodal functions reflection may push mutants into opposite-face basins, giving no net gain or slight regression on F7 if rho is too large.","ablation_plan":"Compare rho in {0.0 (clip baseline), 0.25, 0.5, 0.75} across F1,F7,F10 over 25 seeds; report repaired-trial success rate and mean cosine of repair displacement.","nearest_known_methods":["reflection boundary handling","midpoint-target repair","random reinitialization of violated coordinates"],"implementation_requirements":"Modify the boundary repair function in lshade_canonical.py; add rho parameter; log per-trial repair flag and displacement cosine for ablation."}
